name: Mamiya Yumehisa
source:
The mysterious unexisting leader of the other Mamiyas. [spoiler]His objective is to exist in the world by whatever means necessary. He uses Natsume to carry his plan forward. He's concerned about the friends he had before his death.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/MAMIYA]TV Tropes[/url]]
